Artistix Avian Laptop Backpack – Black | High Density Nylon | 32L Capacity

The Artistix Avian Laptop Backpack is designed for modern professionals, students, and travelers who need durability, comfort, and smart organization in one sleek package. Crafted in high density nylon with a classic black color, this backpack combines lightweight construction with premium strength, making it ideal for daily office use, college, business travel, and weekend commuting.

With precise dimensions of 46 (H) x 32 (W) x 20 (D) cms and a spacious 32 litres capacity, the Artistix Avian Laptop Backpack offers ample room for laptops, documents, accessories, and personal essentials while maintaining a streamlined profile. Despite its generous storage, it weighs only 1.2 kg, ensuring all-day carrying comfort.

Premium Build & Durable Material

Built using high density nylon material, the Artistix Avian Laptop Backpack delivers excellent resistance against wear, daily abrasion, and light moisture. This tough fabric ensures long-lasting performance without compromising on style, making it suitable for both formal and casual environments.

Smart Storage & Laptop Protection

The intelligently designed interior of the  features a dedicated padded laptop compartment that securely fits most laptops up to 15.6 inches. Multiple internal pockets help organize chargers, notebooks, files, and gadgets, while the spacious main compartment easily accommodates books, clothes, or travel essentials.

  • Dedicated padded laptop compartment for enhanced protection
  • Large main compartment with 32 litres capacity
  • Multiple organizer pockets for accessories and documents
  • Quick-access front pocket for daily essentials

Ergonomic Design for Everyday Comfort

Comfort is a key highlight of The ergonomically designed shoulder straps are padded to reduce pressure on the shoulders, while the breathable back panel improves airflow during extended use. The lightweight 1.2 kg construction ensures reduced strain, even when the is fully loaded.

  • Padded, adjustable shoulder straps for superior comfort
  • Breathable back panel for all-day wear
  • Balanced weight distribution for easy carrying

Perfect for Office, College & Travel

Whether you are heading to the office, attending college, or traveling for business, the adapts effortlessly to your lifestyle. Its sleek black design pairs well with professional attire, while the durable construction makes it reliable for daily commuting and short trips.

The compact yet spacious dimensions of 46 x 32 x 20 cms allow it to fit comfortably in overhead compartments and under seats, making it a practical choice for frequent travelers. The water-resistant high density nylon material adds an extra layer of protection for your valuables.

Key Specifications

  • Product Name: Artistix Avian Laptop Backpack
  • Color: Black
  • Material: High Density Nylon
  • Dimensions: 46 (H) x 32 (W) x 20 (D) cms
  • Capacity: 32 Litres
  • Weight: 1.2 Kg

Avian- Discover the perfect blend of durability and style with our solid backpack, designed to maintain its shape no matter where your day takes you. Built with a sturdy, structured design and high-quality materials, this backpack offers long-lasting support for all your essentials.

  • PREMIUM MATERIAL: Made from high-density water-repellent reverse coated matt finish nylon material. Highly smooth zippers & puller.
  • ORGANISED DESIGN: This backpack has spacious compartment with built in soft padded sleeves to protect your laptop /Tablet/iPad. Spacious enough to hold your clothes, files, documents etc. Includes pockets for power bank, hard disk, wallet etc. Front bottom pocket for small items. Side pockets for water bottle, umbrella etc. The main zipper compartment is secured with a magnetic flap closure having small pocket inside for keys. Soft handle for better comfort.
  • ANTI- THEFT DESIGN & CAPACITY: One hidden zipper pocket equips on the back to pack your money, cards, and wallet. This invisible design increases the security of your belongings.
  • USB FEATURE: External USB port with built-in charging cable enables convenient charging by connecting your power bank with your electronic devices.
  • TROLLEY STRAP: The invertible pull rod box design allows the bag to slide over the luggage handle for easy mobility during traveling. Adjustable and padded shoulder straps make it comfortable during use.
